Engineering Intern - Summer 2027

Company:

Boeing United Kingdom Limited

This 3-month Engineering internship is based within Boeing’s Aerospace Innovation Centre (AIC) and supports an Aerospace Engineering Research and Technology Development Programme delivered in collaboration with industry-leading partners and academic institutions.

The position will support the engineering activities relating to storage, distribution and structures integration technologies, helping to drive innovation from research through to practical application. Working in a highly collaborative environment, this role will contribute to the successful delivery of engineering programme activities aligned with Boeing’s innovation and technology objectives.

The ideal candidate will have the ability to work collaboratively within a diverse, geographically dispersed, innovative engineering environment while supporting time-sensitive tasks and prioritising effectively.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Support the engineering team with the structural design and analysis activities for an Aerospace Engineering Research and Technology Development Programme.
